name: Chung Hwa Pulp Corporation
summary: Chung Hwa Pulp Corporation manufactures, sells, and distributes pulp, paper, paperboard, chemical products, and by-products in Taiwan and Mainland China. The company offers specialty paper for the non-plastic food safety, label, tape, food and drinking, medical, interior decoration, garment and fast fashion, and other industries; pulp products for printing, publishing, packaging, and pulp molding applications; fine paper and paperboard for packaging, printing, and office supply; masking and packaging tape; hydrochloric acids, sodium hydroxide, sodium hypochlorite, and sodium chlorite; and forestry resources and bio-based materials.
